title: Wells of Joy
traveler_why: Scout the Seeker finds the joy first and cannot keep it — running to tell everyone that Heavenly Father helped Grandma feel better.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to find joy and share it with everyone. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s grandma got better after being sick, and Scout was so happy and grateful. Scout couldn’t hold the joy in — running to tell everyone, “Heavenly Father helped Grandma feel better!” Soon the whole family was smiling and thankful. Just like Isaiah sang about drawing up joy and telling everyone, Scout discovered that shared joy grows even bigger.
